columns.description: Unit Id.

columns.name: num_spikes_used
columns.description: Spikes the metrics were computed over, where the pipeline reports it apart from core.units.n_spikes.

columns.name: presence_ratio
columns.description: Fraction of the recording in which the unit fired.

columns.name: firing_range
columns.description: Spread of the unit's firing rate over the recording.

columns.name: snr
columns.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the unit's waveform.

columns.name: isi_violations_ratio
columns.description: Refractory violations as a ratio to chance.

columns.name: isi_violations_count
columns.description: Refractory violations counted.

columns.name: rp_contamination
columns.description: Contamination estimated from the refractory period.

columns.name: rp_violations
columns.description: Refractory-period violations counted.

columns.name: sliding_rp_violation
columns.description: Contamination from the sliding refractory estimate. Populated for 2,555 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: amplitude_cutoff
columns.description: Estimated fraction of spikes lost below threshold. Populated for 4,277 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: amplitude_median
columns.description: Median spike amplitude, in the sorting's own units.

columns.name: amplitude_cv_median
columns.description: Median of the amplitude coefficient of variation. Populated for 3,857 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: amplitude_cv_range
columns.description: Range of the amplitude coefficient of variation. Populated for 3,857 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: isolation_distance
columns.description: Mahalanobis distance at which as many other spikes fall inside as the unit has.

columns.name: l_ratio
columns.description: Contamination measured in the same feature space. Populated for 4,484 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: d_prime
columns.description: Linear-discriminant separation from the neighbouring cluster.

columns.name: silhouette
columns.description: Silhouette score in the feature space.

columns.name: nn_hit_rate
columns.description: Nearest-neighbour hit rate.

columns.name: nn_miss_rate
columns.description: Nearest-neighbour miss rate.

columns.name: drift_ptp
columns.description: Peak-to-peak drift of the unit's position. Populated for 2,531 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: drift_std
columns.description: Standard deviation of that drift. Populated for 2,531 of 4,559 units measured.

columns.name: drift_mad
columns.description: Median absolute deviation of that drift. Populated for 2,531 of 4,559 units measured.

rules.message: presence_ratio falls outside 0-1, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, presence_ratio FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE presence_ratio IS NOT NULL AND (presence_ratio < 0 OR presence_ratio > 1)

rules.message: amplitude_cutoff falls outside 0-0.5, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, amplitude_cutoff FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE amplitude_cutoff IS NOT NULL AND (amplitude_cutoff < 0 OR amplitude_cutoff > 0.5)

rules.message: rp_contamination falls outside 0-1, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, rp_contamination FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE rp_contamination IS NOT NULL AND (rp_contamination < 0 OR rp_contamination > 1)

rules.message: nn_hit_rate falls outside 0-1, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, nn_hit_rate FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE nn_hit_rate IS NOT NULL AND (nn_hit_rate < 0 OR nn_hit_rate > 1)

rules.message: nn_miss_rate falls outside 0-1, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, nn_miss_rate FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE nn_miss_rate IS NOT NULL AND (nn_miss_rate < 0 OR nn_miss_rate > 1)

rules.message: silhouette falls outside -1-1, which its definition does not allow
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, silhouette FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE silhouette IS NOT NULL AND (silhouette < -1 OR silhouette > 1)
SELECT session_id, unit_id FROM aind_unit_qc.metrics WHERE isi_violations_count < 0 OR rp_violations < 0

rules.message: a waveform width is zero or negative, which no waveform has
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id FROM aind_unit_qc.waveform_metrics WHERE peak_to_valley <= 0 OR half_width <= 0

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session Id.

columns.name: unit_id
columns.description: Unit Id.

columns.name: synchrony_size
columns.description: How many units must fire together to count, which the sorter computes over a list of sizes -- 2, 4 and 8 in every session measured.

columns.name: sync_spike
columns.description: Fraction of the unit's spikes that fall in a synchronous event of this size.

rules.message: a synchrony size below two describes a unit firing with itself
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, unit_id, synchrony_size FROM aind_unit_qc.synchrony WHERE synchrony_size < 2
SELECT session_id, unit_id, synchrony_size FROM aind_unit_qc.synchrony WHERE sync_spike IS NOT NULL AND (sync_spike < 0 OR sync_spike > 1)

rules.message: a larger synchrony size is reported as more common than a smaller one, which its nesting forbids
rules.sql: SELECT a.session_id, a.unit_id, a.synchrony_size, b.synchrony_size AS larger FROM aind_unit_qc.synchrony AS a JOIN aind_unit_qc.synchrony AS b ON a.unit_id = b.unit_id AND a.synchrony_size < b.synchrony_size WHERE a.sync_spike IS NOT NULL AND b.sync_spike IS NOT NULL AND b.sync_spike > a.sync_spike
